definitions.explanation: An organized social or public gathering.
Activities or performances held for enjoyment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{催|もよお}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加：02498_sanka⟧。
examples.english: I participated in a local event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{色々|いろいろ}な→色々：02352_iroiro⟧{催|もよお}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予定|よてい}されている→予定：00824_yotei⟧。
examples.english: Various events are scheduled for this week.

examples.japanese: {催|もよお}し⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received information about the entertainment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏祭|なつまつ}り→夏祭り：09871_natsumatsuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}な→様々：01559_samazama⟧{催|もよお}し⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Various entertainments are held at the summer festival.

notes:
{催|もよお}し is the noun form of the verb ⟦{催|もよお}す→催す：11517_moyoosu⟧ (to hold/organize an event), referring to organized events or gatherings.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {催|もよお}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加：02498_sanka⟧ (to participate in an event)
- {催|もよお}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (to hold an event)
- {催|もよお}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧ (event announcement)

COMPOUNDS:
- {催|もよお}し⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧: Event, entertainment, show
- {催|もよお}し⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧: Event venue

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {催|もよお}し vs. ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧: ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧ is the loanword commonly used; {催|もよお}し is more traditional/formal Japanese.
- {催|もよお}し vs. ⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧: ⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧ refers to regular or traditional events (school events, ceremonies); {催|もよお}し is broader and includes entertainment.

Register: Neutral to slightly formal. {催|もよお}し⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (entertainments) is common in formal announcements.
